newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar futures end firm, May tests resistance.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar futures end firm, May tests resistance.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar futures continued to push higher during Wednesday evening trading, bouyed by a strong New York market, and ended firmer across the spectrum.
Traders said spot May tested the waters above $312.50 resistance at one point before closing just below the highs as the position continued to square up ahead of expiry next week.
The trend was reflective of New York futures, where technical strength lifted that market to six-month peaks.
May closed at $312.50 a tonne, slightly off seven-week highs, but still up $1.90 from Tuesday. Turnover was 6,462 lots.

Traders said the London market was likely to see more more against actuals and crosses in the overall volume as part of the usual book-squaring before the spot May contract goes off the board next week.
